activity.notes: Moïse Tshombe led the secessionist State of Katanga as president from its declaration of independence on 11 July 1960 until Katanga's secession ended on 21 January 1963.

sources.title: Foreign Relations of the United States, 1958–1960, Africa, Volume XIV, Document 114
sources.citation_text: The U.S. Department of State record documents Tshombe, president of Katanga's provincial government, and Katanga's 11 July 1960 declaration of independence.

sources.title: Foreign Relations of the United States, 1961–1963, Volume XX, Congo Crisis, Document 76
sources.citation_text: The Department of State record identifies Tshombe as Katangan President during the secession.
